factions.name: The Nine Sisters
factions.description: The nine archetypal forces governing warmth, testing, memory, gravity, dreams, paths, silence, awakening, and observation.

factions.name: The Stillward Congregation
factions.description: Keepers of the Stilling Bell and curated serenity. Once united with the Ashen Covenant before the Great Schism.

factions.name: The Ashen Covenant
factions.description: Forge-tenders and archivists who burn away shallow certainties and preserve distilled belief in the Ember Vaults.

factions.name: The Lanternwrights
factions.description: Artisans and caravan brokers of Solstice Crossing who craft prism lamps, chart shifting roads, and trade in Echoes.

factions.name: The Unbound
factions.description: Dream-walkers and memory-remnants who navigate the Veil without pledging to Prism or Quasar.
